guide.title: Different strengths. The same attention.
guide.intro: Meet three fictional barber profiles created for this example. Stock photographs illustrate the setting and craft, not these named people.

notes.title: Alex · classic & textured
notes.text: A sample profile focused on scissor cuts, texture, and shapes that settle naturally between visits. Choose Alex in the appointment preview.

notes.title: Jordan · fades & detail
notes.text: A sample profile centered on clipper work, clean transitions, and careful beard shaping. Choose Jordan to see how a barber-specific booking can work.

notes.title: Sam · longer styles & restyles
notes.text: A sample profile for clients changing length or looking for a new silhouette. The consultation leaves room for reference photos and everyday styling habits.

notes.title: Not sure who to choose?
notes.text: Select “First available” in the preview. A real shop could match the service and the next suitable appointment without asking you to guess.

faq.q: Can I bring a reference photo?
faq.a: Yes. A real consultation would discuss your hair type, growth, length, and daily routine before agreeing a direction.
That is a business policy to confirm with a real shop. This fictional example demonstrates appointment selection and does not claim live availability.

faq.q: Are these real barbers and times?
faq.a: No. Names, profiles, prices, and appointment windows are sample data. Nothing is booked or paid for here.
